title: Buttons on a record type
sub: The “Spell” type: a “Cast” button, a “Dismiss” button only for lasting spells, the “Upkeep” anchor.
start: there is a “Durations” table (instant and concentration), a “Spell” type with a “Duration” property, and the effects “Cast” (it applies “Spell is active”), “Dismiss” and “Upkeep”. The type has no buttons yet.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.sum: “Spell” has two buttons: “Cast” takes the record's “Duration”, “Dismiss” shows only if the duration lasts.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.sum: “Cast” is tied to the “Upkeep” anchor, a separate anchor for each casting: remove the anchor and the spell ends. No errors.

alone.title: On your own
alone.sum: You checked the button's condition on a new duration without hints.

open.lead: Spells have a “Duration”: instant or concentration. The rows of the “Durations” table know whether a duration lasts (“Lasts” yes or no). The spell's buttons should read this from the record, not from the author's head.
open.result: The “Spell” type is open: it has a “Duration” property.

cast.say: Add a button that calls “Cast” and takes the “Duration” from the record.
cast.hint: “Calls the effect” lists no effects that hang on the sheet — only buttons. “Duration” fills in by itself: the property has the same name as the input.
cast.add: In “Buttons on the sheet”, press “+ button”.
cast.result: The “Cast” button takes the “Duration” from the record.

stop.say: Add a second button that calls “Dismiss”.
stop.pick: In the new button, in “Calls the effect”, choose “Dismiss”.

if.say: Show “Dismiss” only for records whose duration lasts.
if.pick: In the list, pick the line that goes from “Duration” to “Lasts”.
if.result: “Dismiss” appears only on records with a lasting duration.

bond.lead: While the spell lasts, the “Upkeep” anchor hangs on the caster. You do not place it with a step: the tie to an anchor places it itself when “Cast” applies something. Remove the anchor and everything this casting applied ends; something applied without a tie would stay hanging.
bond.props: If you cannot see the properties, press “properties” next to the effect name.
bond.add: In the properties, press “tie to an anchor” (the button starts with a plus). “Upkeep” will appear in “Anchor”.

many.say: In “How many anchors”, choose “its own for each action”: a new casting does not release the previous one.
many.result: Each casting has its own anchor.

problems.say: In the header, press the “No problems” button (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). There must be no errors.

term.lead: The last task is without hints.
term.goal: the “Durations” table has at least two durations with “Lasts” set to yes; “Dismiss” shows for each such duration and not for “Instant”; there are no errors in “Problems”.
term.say: Add one more duration to the “Durations” table with “Lasts” set to yes, and check that “Dismiss” shows for it and not for “Instant”.
term.hint: The “Durations” table is under “Rules” → “Tables”. Fill in the new row like “Concentration”.
term.result: “Dismiss” shows for the new duration and not for “Instant”.
